malik.title: Day 1/30: He Has $23. His Mom Owes $1,400. You Decide What He Does 👇 #shorts
malik.description:

Malik, 18, carries fish crates at 5 AM for his mom's stand. The rent is overdue: $1,400. Then he sees the poster: Brickport Open wrestling tournament, $5,000 prize, in 30 days.

🗳️ YOU decide: comment A or B!

B) He takes an extra night shift at the docks

The most voted choice becomes tomorrow's episode.
